sanskrit: praya̍jyavo ma̱ruto̱ bhrāja̍dṛṣṭayo bṛ̱had vayo̍ dadhire ru̱kmava̍kṣasaḥ | īya̍nte̱ aśvai̍ḥ su̱yame̍bhir ā̱śubhi̱ḥ śubha̍ṁ yā̱tām anu̱ rathā̍ avṛtsata ||
english: Worthy of prior worship, the Maruts with their gleaming spear-points have assumed great vigour, adorned with golden ornaments on their chests; they are set in motion by well-reined, swift horses — may the chariots roll after them in glorious array.

sanskrit: sva̱yaṁ da̍dhidhve̱ tavi̍ṣī̱ṁ yathā̍ vi̱da bṛ̱han ma̍hānta urvi̱yā vi rā̍jatha | u̱tāntari̍kṣam mamire̱ vy oja̍sā̱ śubha̍ṁ yā̱tām anu̱ rathā̍ avṛtsata ||
english: You have assumed your own might as you know how; vast, great, you shine wide and far; you have measured out the mid-air (the atmosphere) with your strength — may the chariots roll after them in glorious array.

sanskrit: sā̱kaṁ jā̱tāḥ su̱bhva̍ḥ sā̱kam u̍kṣi̱tāḥ śri̱ye ci̱d ā pra̍ta̱raṁ vā̍vṛdhu̱r nara̍ḥ | vi̱ro̱kiṇa̱ḥ sūrya̍syeva ra̱śmaya̱ḥ śubha̍ṁ yā̱tām anu̱ rathā̍ avṛtsata ||
english: Born together, goodly in form, growing together, these heroes have increased ever more for splendour; blazing like the rays of the sun — may the chariots roll after them in glorious array.

sanskrit: ā̱bhū̱ṣeṇya̍ṁ vo maruto mahitva̱naṁ di̍dṛ̱kṣeṇya̱ṁ sūrya̍syeva̱ cakṣa̍ṇam | u̱to a̱smām̐ a̍mṛta̱tve da̍dhātana̱ śubha̍ṁ yā̱tām anu̱ rathā̍ avṛtsata ||
english: Your greatness, O Maruts, is worthy of adornment, worthy of beholding like the eye of the sun; establish us also in immortality — may the chariots roll after them in glorious array.

sanskrit: ud ī̍rayathā marutaḥ samudra̱to yū̱yaṁ vṛ̱ṣṭiṁ va̍rṣayathā purīṣiṇaḥ | na vo̍ dasrā̱ upa̍ dasyanti dhe̱nava̱ḥ śubha̍ṁ yā̱tām anu̱ rathā̍ avṛtsata ||
english: You stir up the rain-laden clouds from the ocean, O Maruts; you, full of water, pour down the rain; your abundant milch-cows do not fail — may the chariots roll after them in glorious array.

sanskrit: yad aśvā̍n dhū̱rṣu pṛṣa̍tī̱r ayu̍gdhvaṁ hira̱ṇyayā̱n praty atkā̱m̐ amu̍gdhvam | viśvā̱ it spṛdho̍ maruto̱ vy a̍syatha̱ śubha̍ṁ yā̱tām anu̱ rathā̍ avṛtsata ||
english: When you yoked the dappled deer to the shafts and put on your golden mantles, you scatter all your foes, O Maruts — may the chariots roll after them in glorious array.

sanskrit: na parva̍tā̱ na na̱dyo̍ varanta vo̱ yatrāci̍dhvam maruto̱ gaccha̱thed u̱ tat | u̱ta dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī yā̍thanā̱ pari̱ śubha̍ṁ yā̱tām anu̱ rathā̍ avṛtsata ||
english: Neither mountains nor rivers hinder you; wherever you have aimed, O Maruts, there you go; you encompass even heaven and earth — may the chariots roll after them in glorious array.

sanskrit: yat pū̱rvyam ma̍ruto̱ yac ca̱ nūta̍na̱ṁ yad u̱dyate̍ vasavo̱ yac ca̍ śa̱syate̍ | viśva̍sya̱ tasya̍ bhavathā̱ nave̍dasa̱ḥ śubha̍ṁ yā̱tām anu̱ rathā̍ avṛtsata ||
english: Whatever is ancient, O Maruts, whatever is new, whatever is just now proclaimed, O Vasus, or is yet to be proclaimed — you are the knowers of all that — may the chariots roll after them in glorious array.

sanskrit: mṛ̱ḻata̍ no maruto̱ mā va̍dhiṣṭanā̱smabhya̱ṁ śarma̍ bahu̱laṁ vi ya̍ntana | adhi̍ sto̱trasya̍ sa̱khyasya̍ gātana̱ śubha̍ṁ yā̱tām anu̱ rathā̍ avṛtsata ||
english: Be gracious to us, O Maruts; do not smite us; extend abundant shelter to us; attend to our hymn of praise, to our friendship — may the chariots roll after them in glorious array.

sanskrit: yū̱yam a̱smān na̍yata̱ vasyo̱ acchā̱ nir a̍ṁha̱tibhyo̍ maruto gṛṇā̱nāḥ | ju̱ṣadhva̍ṁ no ha̱vyadā̍tiṁ yajatrā va̱yaṁ syā̍ma̱ pata̍yo rayī̱ṇām ||
english: Lead us toward better fortune, O Maruts, being praised; free us from troubles, O adorable ones; accept our oblation offered with the ladle — may we be lords of riches.

sanskrit: agne̱ śardha̍nta̱m ā ga̱ṇam pi̱ṣṭaṁ ru̱kmebhi̍r a̱ñjibhi̍ḥ | viśo̍ a̱dya ma̱rutā̱m ava̍ hvaye di̱vaś ci̍d roca̱nād adhi̍ ||
english: O Agni, I invoke today the bold host of the Maruts, adorned with golden ornaments and unguents, the peoples of the Maruts — even from the shining vault of heaven above.

sanskrit: yathā̍ ci̱n manya̍se hṛ̱dā tad in me̍ jagmur ā̱śasa̍ḥ | ye te̱ nedi̍ṣṭha̱ṁ hava̍nāny ā̱gama̱n tān va̍rdha bhī̱masa̍ṁdṛśaḥ ||
english: Just as you think in your heart, so indeed have my desires come to fulfilment; those who have come closest to your invocations — strengthen them, O terrible to behold.

sanskrit: mī̱ḻhuṣma̍tīva pṛthi̱vī parā̍hatā̱ mada̍nty ety a̱smad ā | ṛkṣo̱ na vo̍ maruta̱ḥ śimī̍vā̱m̐ amo̍ du̱dhro gaur i̍va bhīma̱yuḥ ||
english: Like a bountiful earth struck and stirred, she comes exhilarated toward us; like a bear, O Maruts, is the impetuous force of you, mighty and wild, like a fearsome bull.

sanskrit: ni ye ri̱ṇanty oja̍sā̱ vṛthā̱ gāvo̱ na du̱rdhura̍ḥ | aśmā̍naṁ cit sva̱rya1̱̍m parva̍taṁ gi̱rim pra cyā̍vayanti̱ yāma̍bhiḥ ||
english: Those who cast down with their might as effortlessly as cows that are hard to yoke — with their courses they dislodge even the stone, the sky-reaching mountain, the hill.

sanskrit: ut ti̍ṣṭha nū̱nam e̍ṣā̱ṁ stomai̱ḥ samu̍kṣitānām | ma̱rutā̍m puru̱tama̱m apū̍rvya̱ṁ gavā̱ṁ sarga̍m iva hvaye ||
english: Rise up now, being sprinkled with their praises; I call the most abundant, unprecedented gift of the Maruts as one calls a release of cattle.

sanskrit: yu̱ṅgdhvaṁ hy aru̍ṣī̱ rathe̍ yu̱ṅgdhvaṁ rathe̍ṣu ro̱hita̍ḥ | yu̱ṅgdhvaṁ harī̍ aji̱rā dhu̱ri voḻha̍ve̱ vahi̍ṣṭhā dhu̱ri voḻha̍ve ||
english: Harness the tawny mares to the chariot; harness the red steeds to the chariots; harness the swift bay horses to the yoke for drawing — the best bearers to the yoke for drawing.

sanskrit: u̱ta sya vā̱jy a̍ru̱ṣas tu̍vi̱ṣvaṇi̍r i̱ha sma̍ dhāyi darśa̱taḥ | mā vo̱ yāme̍ṣu marutaś ci̱raṁ ka̍ra̱t pra taṁ rathe̍ṣu codata ||
english: And that victorious tawny (steed), roaring loudly, has been set here as the visible one; let him not delay long in your courses, O Maruts — urge him forward in the chariots.

sanskrit: ratha̱ṁ nu māru̍taṁ va̱yaṁ śra̍va̱syum ā hu̍vāmahe | ā yasmi̍n ta̱sthau su̱raṇā̍ni̱ bibhra̍tī̱ sacā̍ ma̱rutsu̍ roda̱sī ||
english: We now call hither the chariot of the Maruts, desirous of fame — the chariot on which the two worlds (heaven and earth), bearing beautiful sounds, have stood together among the Maruts.

sanskrit: taṁ va̱ḥ śardha̍ṁ rathe̱śubha̍ṁ tve̱ṣam pa̍na̱syum ā hu̍ve | yasmi̱n sujā̍tā su̱bhagā̍ mahī̱yate̱ sacā̍ ma̱rutsu̍ mīḻhu̱ṣī ||
english: I call hither that host of yours, glorious in the chariot, impetuous and worthy of praise — that host in which the well-born, fortunate, bounteous one is magnified together among the Maruts.

sanskrit: ā ru̍drāsa̱ indra̍vantaḥ sa̱joṣa̍so̱ hira̍ṇyarathāḥ suvi̱tāya̍ gantana | i̱yaṁ vo̍ a̱smat prati̍ haryate ma̱tis tṛ̱ṣṇaje̱ na di̱va utsā̍ uda̱nyave̍ ||
english: Come, O Rudras, together with Indra, in accord, on your golden chariots, for our well-being; this prayer from us reaches out to you, like a thirsty man's (longing) for a spring of water from heaven.

sanskrit: vāśī̍manta ṛṣṭi̱manto̍ manī̱ṣiṇa̍ḥ su̱dhanvā̍na̱ iṣu̍manto niṣa̱ṅgiṇa̍ḥ | svaśvā̍ḥ stha su̱rathā̍ḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ svāyu̱dhā ma̍ruto yāthanā̱ śubha̍m ||
english: Bearing axes and lances, wise, with good bows, furnished with arrows and quivers — you are well-horsed, with good chariots, sons of Pṛśni, with fine weapons, O Maruts; come beauteously.

sanskrit: dhū̱nu̱tha dyām parva̍tān dā̱śuṣe̱ vasu̱ ni vo̱ vanā̍ jihate̱ yāma̍no bhi̱yā | ko̱paya̍tha pṛthi̱vīm pṛ̍śnimātaraḥ śu̱bhe yad u̍grā̱ḥ pṛṣa̍tī̱r ayu̍gdhvam ||
english: You shake heaven and the mountains to give wealth to the worshipper; the forests bow down at your passage from fear; you agitate the earth, O sons of Pṛśni — when for glory you fierce ones yoked the dappled deer.

sanskrit: vāta̍tviṣo ma̱ruto̍ va̱rṣani̍rṇijo ya̱māiva̱ susa̍dṛśaḥ su̱peśa̍saḥ | pi̱śaṅgā̍śvā aru̱ṇāśvā̍ are̱pasa̱ḥ pratva̍kṣaso mahi̱nā dyaur i̍vo̱rava̍ḥ ||
english: The Maruts with the lustre of the wind, clad in rain-garments, equal and well-formed like twin Yamas, with tawny horses, with reddish-brown horses, spotless, swelling in their bodies, vast as the sky in their greatness.

sanskrit: pu̱ru̱dra̱psā a̍ñji̱manta̍ḥ su̱dāna̍vas tve̱ṣasa̍ṁdṛśo anava̱bhrarā̍dhasaḥ | su̱jā̱tāso̍ ja̱nuṣā̍ ru̱kmava̍kṣaso di̱vo a̱rkā a̱mṛta̱ṁ nāma̍ bhejire ||
english: Adorned with many drops, gleaming with unguents, munificent, terrifying to behold, of inexhaustible bounty — well-born by nature, golden-chested, rays of heaven, they have partaken of the immortal name.

sanskrit: ṛ̱ṣṭayo̍ vo maruto̱ aṁsa̍yo̱r adhi̱ saha̱ ojo̍ bā̱hvor vo̱ bala̍ṁ hi̱tam | nṛ̱mṇā śī̱rṣasv āyu̍dhā̱ rathe̍ṣu vo̱ viśvā̍ va̱ḥ śrīr adhi̍ ta̱nūṣu̍ pipiśe ||
english: The spears on your shoulders, O Maruts, the strength and the power deposited in your arms — manly vigour on your heads, weapons in your chariots — all splendour has been wrought upon your bodies.

sanskrit: goma̱d aśvā̍va̱d ratha̍vat su̱vīra̍ṁ ca̱ndrava̱d rādho̍ maruto dadā naḥ | praśa̍stiṁ naḥ kṛṇuta rudriyāso bhakṣī̱ya vo 'va̍so̱ daivya̍sya ||
english: Grant us, O Maruts, wealth rich in cattle, rich in horses, with good chariots, with excellent heroes, brilliant in beauty; make our praise renowned, O sons of Rudra — may I partake of your divine favour.

sanskrit: ha̱ye naro̱ maru̍to mṛ̱ḻatā̍ na̱s tuvī̍maghāso̱ amṛ̍tā̱ ṛta̍jñāḥ | satya̍śruta̱ḥ kava̍yo̱ yuvā̍no̱ bṛha̍dgirayo bṛ̱had u̱kṣamā̍ṇāḥ ||
english: Ho, O heroic Maruts, be gracious to us — O you of mighty gifts, immortal, knowing the cosmic order; truly renowned, wise, youthful, of mighty voice, loudly roaring.

sanskrit: tam u̍ nū̱naṁ tavi̍ṣīmantam eṣāṁ stu̱ṣe ga̱ṇam māru̍ta̱ṁ navya̍sīnām | ya ā̱śva̍śvā̱ ama̍va̱d vaha̍nta u̱teśi̍re a̱mṛta̍sya sva̱rāja̍ḥ ||
english: Now indeed I praise this mighty host of the Maruts, worthy of fresh praise — those who powerfully draw swift-horsed chariots and rule as self-sovereigns over the immortal realm.

sanskrit: tve̱ṣaṁ ga̱ṇaṁ ta̱vasa̱ṁ khādi̍hasta̱ṁ dhuni̍vratam mā̱yina̱ṁ dāti̍vāram | ma̱yo̱bhuvo̱ ye ami̍tā mahi̱tvā vanda̍sva vipra tuvi̱rādha̍so̱ nṝn ||
english: Praise, O wise man, this impetuous host, mighty, with rings of metal on their hands, intent on shaking, possessing magical powers, munificent — those unlimited in greatness, producing happiness, richly rewarding men.

sanskrit: ā vo̍ yantūdavā̱hāso̍ a̱dya vṛ̱ṣṭiṁ ye viśve̍ ma̱ruto̍ ju̱nanti̍ | a̱yaṁ yo a̱gnir ma̍ruta̱ḥ sami̍ddha e̱taṁ ju̍ṣadhvaṁ kavayo yuvānaḥ ||
english: May those who carry water come here today, all the Maruts who urge on the rain; this fire, O Maruts, that is kindled — come enjoy this, O wise and youthful ones.

sanskrit: yū̱yaṁ rājā̍na̱m irya̱ṁ janā̍ya vibhvata̱ṣṭaṁ ja̍nayathā yajatrāḥ | yu̱ṣmad e̍ti muṣṭi̱hā bā̱hujū̍to yu̱ṣmat sada̍śvo marutaḥ su̱vīra̍ḥ ||
english: You, the adorable ones, generate for the people the king Irya, fashioned by Vibhva; from you comes the fist-fighter, propelled by his arms; from you, O Maruts, comes he of good horses and brave heroes.

sanskrit: a̱rā i̱ved aca̍ramā̱ ahe̍va̱ pra-pra̍ jāyante̱ aka̍vā̱ maho̍bhiḥ | pṛśne̍ḥ pu̱trā u̍pa̱māso̱ rabhi̍ṣṭhā̱ḥ svayā̍ ma̱tyā ma̱ruta̱ḥ sam mi̍mikṣuḥ ||
english: Like spokes that are not the last, like days, they are born again and again, unceasing, through their greatness; sons of Pṛśni, supreme and vigorous — the Maruts have poured forth by their own will.

sanskrit: yat prāyā̍siṣṭa̱ pṛṣa̍tībhi̱r aśvai̍r vīḻupa̱vibhi̍r maruto̱ rathe̍bhiḥ | kṣoda̍nta̱ āpo̍ riṇa̱te vanā̱ny avo̱sriyo̍ vṛṣa̱bhaḥ kra̍ndatu̱ dyauḥ ||
english: When you set forth, O Maruts, with your dappled horses and firm-wheeled chariots, the waters rush along, the forests bend, the she-cattle are loosened; let the bull (thunder) roar in the sky.

sanskrit: prathi̍ṣṭa̱ yāma̍n pṛthi̱vī ci̍d eṣā̱m bharte̍va̱ garbha̱ṁ svam ic chavo̍ dhuḥ | vātā̱n hy aśvā̍n dhu̱ry ā̍yuyu̱jre va̱rṣaṁ sveda̍ṁ cakrire ru̱driyā̍saḥ ||
english: The earth spreads wide at their passing; as a nursing mother their might shakes the earth like its own womb; they have yoked wind-swift horses to the shaft, and the sons of Rudra have made rain their sweat.

sanskrit: ha̱ye naro̱ maru̍to mṛ̱ḻatā̍ na̱s tuvī̍maghāso̱ amṛ̍tā̱ ṛta̍jñāḥ | satya̍śruta̱ḥ kava̍yo̱ yuvā̍no̱ bṛha̍dgirayo bṛ̱had u̱kṣamā̍ṇāḥ ||
english: Ho, O heroic Maruts, be gracious to us — O you of mighty gifts, immortal, knowing the cosmic order; truly renowned, wise, youthful, of mighty voice, loudly roaring.

sanskrit: pra va̱ḥ spaḻ a̍kran suvi̱tāya̍ dā̱vane 'rcā̍ di̱ve pra pṛ̍thi̱vyā ṛ̱tam bha̍re | u̱kṣante̱ aśvā̱n taru̍ṣanta̱ ā rajo 'nu̱ svam bhā̱nuṁ śra̍thayante arṇa̱vaiḥ ||
english: Your swift scout has run forth to give good fortune; I bring forward with a hymn the cosmic order for heaven and earth; they bathe their horses, they cross the dust (atmosphere), they loosen themselves after their own lustre with their streams.

sanskrit: amā̍d eṣām bhi̱yasā̱ bhūmi̍r ejati̱ naur na pū̱rṇā kṣa̍rati̱ vyathi̍r ya̱tī | dū̱re̱dṛśo̱ ye ci̱taya̍nta̱ ema̍bhir a̱ntar ma̱he vi̱dathe̍ yetire̱ nara̍ḥ ||
english: The earth trembles from their abode through fear; like a full ship she drifts, shaking as she goes; visible from afar, they who illumine with their flashes — these heroes have striven in the great assembly.

sanskrit: gavā̍m iva śri̱yase̱ śṛṅga̍m utta̱maṁ sūryo̱ na cakṣū̱ raja̍so vi̱sarja̍ne | atyā̍ iva su̱bhva1̱̍ś cāra̍vaḥ sthana̱ maryā̍iva śri̱yase̍ cetathā naraḥ ||
english: Like the highest horn of cattle for beauty, like the eye of the sun when the atmosphere is released — you stand like goodly, handsome race-horses; like young men, you heroes are observed for their beauty.

sanskrit: ko vo̍ ma̱hānti̍ maha̱tām ud a̍śnava̱t kas kāvyā̍ maruta̱ḥ ko ha̱ pauṁsyā̍ | yū̱yaṁ ha̱ bhūmi̍ṁ ki̱raṇa̱ṁ na re̍jatha̱ pra yad bhara̍dhve suvi̱tāya̍ dā̱vane̍ ||
english: Who has reached the great deeds of you the great? Who your wisdom, O Maruts? Who your manliness? You make the earth tremble like a dust cloud when you carry gifts forward for good fortune.

sanskrit: aśvā̍ i̱ved a̍ru̱ṣāsa̱ḥ saba̍ndhava̱ḥ śūrā̍ iva pra̱yudha̱ḥ prota yu̍yudhuḥ | maryā̍ iva su̱vṛdho̍ vāvṛdhu̱r nara̱ḥ sūrya̍sya̱ cakṣu̱ḥ pra mi̍nanti vṛ̱ṣṭibhi̍ḥ ||
english: Like tawny horses of the same kin, like heroes going forth to battle they have striven; like young men grown to full vigour, the heroes have grown; they dim the eye of the sun with their rains.

sanskrit: te a̍jye̱ṣṭhā aka̍niṣṭhāsa u̱dbhido 'ma̍dhyamāso̱ maha̍sā̱ vi vā̍vṛdhuḥ | su̱jā̱tāso̍ ja̱nuṣā̱ pṛśni̍mātaro di̱vo maryā̱ ā no̱ acchā̍ jigātana ||
english: They have no eldest or youngest, no middlemost; they have grown in greatness as those who spring up spontaneously; well-born by nature, sons of Pṛśni — O youthful heroes of the sky, come here to us.

sanskrit: vayo̱ na ye śreṇī̍ḥ pa̱ptur oja̱sāntā̍n di̱vo bṛ̍ha̱taḥ sānu̍na̱s pari̍ | aśvā̍sa eṣām u̱bhaye̱ yathā̍ vi̱duḥ pra parva̍tasya nabha̱nūm̐r a̍cucyavuḥ ||
english: Like birds they have flown in rows with might around the ridges of broad heaven; their horses, both kinds as they know, have shaken loose the water-veins of the mountain.

sanskrit: mimā̍tu̱ dyaur adi̍tir vī̱taye̍ na̱ḥ saṁ dānu̍citrā u̱ṣaso̍ yatantām | ācu̍cyavur di̱vyaṁ kośa̍m e̱ta ṛṣe̍ ru̱drasya̍ ma̱ruto̍ gṛṇā̱nāḥ ||
english: Let heaven measure out for our enjoyment; let the Dawns, rich in dew, strive together; these Maruts, praised, sons of the Ṛṣi Rudra, have shaken loose the heavenly treasure-chest.

sanskrit: īḻe̍ a̱gniṁ svava̍sa̱ṁ namo̍bhir i̱ha pra̍sa̱tto vi ca̍yat kṛ̱taṁ na̍ḥ | rathai̍r iva̱ pra bha̍re vāja̱yadbhi̍ḥ pradakṣi̱ṇin ma̱rutā̱ṁ stoma̍m ṛdhyām ||
english: I praise Agni with homages as self-sheltered; set in place here, may he discern our ritual act; as if going forth with prize-seeking chariots, may I prosper the hymn of the Maruts turning clockwise.

sanskrit: ā ye ta̱sthuḥ pṛṣa̍tīṣu śru̱tāsu̍ su̱kheṣu̍ ru̱drā ma̱ruto̱ rathe̍ṣu | vanā̍ cid ugrā jihate̱ ni vo̍ bhi̱yā pṛ̍thi̱vī ci̍d rejate̱ parva̍taś cit ||
english: Who have taken their stand on the famous, well-seated dappled mares, O Rudras, O Maruts, in your chariots — even the forests, O terrible ones, bow down before you in fear; even the earth trembles; even the mountain.

sanskrit: parva̍taś ci̱n mahi̍ vṛ̱ddho bi̍bhāya di̱vaś ci̱t sānu̍ rejata sva̱ne va̍ḥ | yat krīḻa̍tha maruta ṛṣṭi̱manta̱ āpa̍ iva sa̱dhrya̍ñco dhavadhve ||
english: Even the great, lofty mountain is afraid; even the ridge of heaven trembles at your roar; when you sport together, O Maruts with your spears, you rush along like converging waters.

sanskrit: va̱rā i̱ved rai̍va̱tāso̱ hira̍ṇyair a̱bhi sva̱dhābhi̍s ta̱nva̍ḥ pipiśre | śri̱ye śreyā̍ṁsas ta̱vaso̱ rathe̍ṣu sa̱trā mahā̍ṁsi cakrire ta̱nūṣu̍ ||
english: Like choice thoroughbreds (raivatas), they have adorned their bodies with gold and with their own natures; surpassing in beauty, mighty in their chariots — jointly they have wrought greatness upon their bodies.

sanskrit: a̱jye̱ṣṭhāso̱ aka̍niṣṭhāsa e̱te sam bhrāta̍ro vāvṛdhu̱ḥ saubha̍gāya | yuvā̍ pi̱tā svapā̍ ru̱dra e̍ṣāṁ su̱dughā̱ pṛśni̍ḥ su̱dinā̍ ma̱rudbhya̍ḥ ||
english: These, having neither eldest nor youngest, have grown together as brothers for good fortune; Rudra, their ever-young father of good works — Pṛśni, richly milking, is fair-days-giving for the Maruts.

sanskrit: yad u̍tta̱me ma̍ruto madhya̱me vā̱ yad vā̍va̱me su̍bhagāso di̱vi ṣṭha | ato̍ no rudrā u̱ta vā̱ nv a1̱̍syāgne̍ vi̱ttād dha̱viṣo̱ yad yajā̍ma ||
english: Whether you are in the highest, O Maruts, or in the middlemost, or in the lowest heaven, O blessed ones — from there, O Rudras, take note of our oblation, O Agni, of the sacrifice which we perform.

sanskrit: a̱gniś ca̱ yan ma̍ruto viśvavedaso di̱vo vaha̍dhva̱ utta̍rā̱d adhi̱ ṣṇubhi̍ḥ | te ma̍ndasā̱nā dhuna̍yo riśādaso vā̱maṁ dha̍tta̱ yaja̍mānāya sunva̱te ||
english: And that which Agni and you, O Maruts, all-knowing, bring from beyond the highest ridges of heaven — be glad and shaking, O destroyers of foes, bestow abundance on the sacrificer who presses the soma.

sanskrit: agne̍ ma̱rudbhi̍ḥ śu̱bhaya̍dbhi̱r ṛkva̍bhi̱ḥ soma̍m piba mandasā̱no ga̍ṇa̱śribhi̍ḥ | pā̱va̱kebhi̍r viśvami̱nvebhi̍r ā̱yubhi̱r vaiśvā̍nara pra̱divā̍ ke̱tunā̍ sa̱jūḥ ||
english: O Agni, drink the soma, rejoicing with the Maruts who make beautiful, who hymn, who lend splendour to the host — with the purifiers, the all-enlivening, the life-promoting ones, O Vaiśvānara, together with your ancient banner.

sanskrit: ke ṣṭhā̍ nara̱ḥ śreṣṭha̍tamā̱ ya eka̍-eka āya̱ya | pa̱ra̱masyā̍ḥ parā̱vata̍ḥ ||
english: Who are you, the most excellent heroes, who have come each singly from the most remote distance?

sanskrit: kva1̱̍ vo 'śvā̱ḥ kvā̱3̱̍bhīśa̍vaḥ ka̱thaṁ śe̍ka ka̱thā ya̍ya | pṛ̱ṣṭhe sado̍ na̱sor yama̍ḥ ||
english: Where are your horses? Where your reins? How did you halt? How did you come? The seat on the back, the yoke of the two nostrils — how was it?

sanskrit: ja̱ghane̱ coda̍ eṣā̱ṁ vi sa̱kthāni̱ naro̍ yamuḥ | pu̱tra̱kṛ̱the na jana̍yaḥ ||
english: Behind them, urged on, the heroes spread their thighs, like women at the act of birth.

sanskrit: parā̍ vīrāsa etana̱ maryā̍so̱ bhadra̍jānayaḥ | a̱gni̱tapo̱ yathāsa̍tha ||
english: Go forth, O heroes, O young men of noble birth — as you are tempered by fire (in Agni's heat).

sanskrit: sana̱t sāśvya̍m pa̱śum u̱ta gavya̍ṁ śa̱tāva̍yam | śyā̱vāśva̍stutāya̱ yā dor vī̱rāyo̍pa̱barbṛ̍hat ||
english: That which is connected with horses, and cattle, and riches of a hundred sheep — she who resounds, praised by Śyāvāśva, bestows the hero's arm's strength upon him.

sanskrit: u̱ta tvā̱ strī śaśī̍yasī pu̱ṁso bha̍vati̱ vasya̍sī | ade̍vatrād arā̱dhasa̍ḥ ||
english: Moreover a woman more vigorous than a man may be more wealthy — from one who is not devoted to the gods and lacks true bounty.

sanskrit: vi yā jā̱nāti̱ jasu̍ri̱ṁ vi tṛṣya̍nta̱ṁ vi kā̱mina̍m | de̱va̱trā kṛ̍ṇu̱te mana̍ḥ ||
english: She who discerns the exhausted man, the thirsty man, the eager man — she turns her mind toward the gods.

sanskrit: u̱ta ghā̱ nemo̱ astu̍ta̱ḥ pumā̱m̐ iti̍ bruve pa̱ṇiḥ | sa vaira̍deya̱ it sa̱maḥ ||
english: And yet surely no man who is unpraised — so says the niggardly Paṇi — he alone is equal to Vairadeva (the hero's reward).

sanskrit: u̱ta me̍ 'rapad yuva̱tir ma̍ma̱nduṣī̱ prati̍ śyā̱vāya̍ varta̱nim | vi rohi̍tā purumī̱ḻhāya̍ yematu̱r viprā̍ya dī̱rghaya̍śase ||
english: And a young exhilarated woman came running toward Śyāva's path; the two red mares have been aimed at the much-lauded Purumīḍha, at the inspired poet of long-enduring fame.

sanskrit: yo me̍ dhenū̱nāṁ śa̱taṁ vaida̍daśvi̱r yathā̱ dada̍t | ta̱ra̱nta i̍va ma̱ṁhanā̍ ||
english: He who gave me a hundred milch-cows as Vaidadaśvi gave — their munificence is like a crossing (of the flood).

sanskrit: ya ī̱ṁ vaha̍nta ā̱śubhi̱ḥ piba̍nto madi̱ram madhu̍ | atra̱ śravā̍ṁsi dadhire ||
english: Those who carry this with their swift horses, drinking the intoxicating sweet drink — here they have established their glories.

sanskrit: yeṣā̍ṁ śri̱yādhi̱ roda̍sī vi̱bhrāja̍nte̱ rathe̱ṣv ā | di̱vi ru̱kma i̍vo̱pari̍ ||
english: By whose splendour the two worlds gleam as if in their chariots — like gold above in the sky.

sanskrit: yuvā̱ sa māru̍to ga̱ṇas tve̱ṣara̍tho̱ ane̍dyaḥ | śu̱bha̱ṁyāvāpra̍tiṣkutaḥ ||
english: Young is this Marut host, of impetuous chariots, unsurpassed, going beauteously, unopposed.

sanskrit: ko ve̍da nū̱nam e̍ṣā̱ṁ yatrā̱ mada̍nti̱ dhūta̍yaḥ | ṛ̱tajā̍tā are̱pasa̍ḥ ||
english: Who now knows where these spotless ones, born from the cosmic order, are exhilarated as they shake?

sanskrit: yū̱yam marta̍ṁ vipanyavaḥ praṇe̱tāra̍ i̱tthā dhi̱yā | śrotā̍ro̱ yāma̍hūtiṣu ||
english: You, O praiseworthy ones, are the leaders of mortal man, guiding him with your thought, the hearers at the callings for your help.

sanskrit: te no̱ vasū̍ni̱ kāmyā̍ puruśca̱ndrā ri̍śādasaḥ | ā ya̍jñiyāso vavṛttana ||
english: May those destroyers of foes, adorable, of manifold brilliance, turn to us with desirable riches.

sanskrit: e̱tam me̱ stoma̍m ūrmye dā̱rbhyāya̱ parā̍ vaha | giro̍ devi ra̱thīr i̍va ||
english: O divine Ūrmī, carry this my hymn forth to Dārbhya, like a charioteer (carries) praises.

sanskrit: u̱ta me̍ vocatā̱d iti̍ su̱taso̍me̱ ratha̍vītau | na kāmo̱ apa̍ veti me ||
english: And let them say to me thus in the presence of Rathavīti who has pressed the soma: 'My desire does not go away from me.'

sanskrit: e̱ṣa kṣe̍ti̱ ratha̍vītir ma̱ghavā̱ goma̍tī̱r anu̍ | parva̍te̱ṣv apa̍śritaḥ ||
english: This Rathavīti the munificent one dwells along the cattle-rich (rivers), resting against the mountains.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tena̍ ṛ̱tam api̍hitaṁ dhru̱vaṁ vā̱ṁ sūrya̍sya̱ yatra̍ vimu̱canty aśvā̍n | daśa̍ śa̱tā sa̱ha ta̍sthu̱s tad eka̍ṁ de̱vānā̱ṁ śreṣṭha̱ṁ vapu̍ṣām apaśyam ||
english: By the cosmic order your firm cosmic order is covered, O Mitra-Varuṇa, where they unyoke the horses of the sun; a thousand ten (ten hundred) have stood together — that one I have seen, the best of divine forms.

sanskrit: tat su vā̍m mitrāvaruṇā mahi̱tvam ī̱rmā ta̱sthuṣī̱r aha̍bhir duduhre | viśvā̍ḥ pinvatha̱ḥ svasa̍rasya̱ dhenā̱ anu̍ vā̱m eka̍ḥ pa̱vir ā va̍varta ||
english: That is your greatness, O Mitra-Varuṇa — the (cows) standing motionless have been milked (like waves) by the days; you two swell all the streams of the heavenly well; one wheel (of the sun) has rolled after you two.

sanskrit: adhā̍rayatam pṛthi̱vīm u̱ta dyām mitra̍rājānā varuṇā̱ maho̍bhiḥ | va̱rdhaya̍ta̱m oṣa̍dhī̱ḥ pinva̍ta̱ṁ gā ava̍ vṛ̱ṣṭiṁ sṛ̍jataṁ jīradānū ||
english: You have upheld the earth and heaven with your greatness, O Mitra and Varuṇa, kings; you cause the plants to grow, you cause the cows to flow with milk; you who give swiftly, send forth the rain.

sanskrit: ā vā̱m aśvā̍saḥ su̱yujo̍ vahantu ya̱tara̍śmaya̱ upa̍ yantv a̱rvāk | ghṛ̱tasya̍ ni̱rṇig anu̍ vartate vā̱m upa̱ sindha̍vaḥ pra̱divi̍ kṣaranti ||
english: May the well-yoked horses bring you hither; may (the reins of) whichever chariot come hitherward; the bright garment of ghee follows after you; the rivers flow for you from ancient times.

sanskrit: anu̍ śru̱tām a̱mati̱ṁ vardha̍d u̱rvīm ba̱rhir i̍va̱ yaju̍ṣā̱ rakṣa̍māṇā | nama̍svantā dhṛtada̱kṣādhi̱ garte̱ mitrāsā̍the varu̱ṇeḻā̍sv a̱ntaḥ ||
english: Following and increasing the famed, vast thought, protecting it like the sacrificial grass with the yajus formula — bowing, holding firm power, within the seat of honour, O Mitra and Varuṇa, you two sit in the Iḍā-offerings.

sanskrit: akra̍vihastā su̱kṛte̍ para̱spā yaṁ trāsā̍the varu̱ṇeḻā̍sv a̱ntaḥ | rājā̍nā kṣa̱tram ahṛ̍ṇīyamānā sa̱hasra̍sthūṇam bibhṛthaḥ sa̱ha dvau ||
english: With bloodless hands, protecting well-doers, protecting mutually — whom you two protect within the Iḍā-offerings; O kings, wielding sovereignty without anger, the two of you bear the thousand-pillared (world) together.

sanskrit: hira̍ṇyanirṇi̱g ayo̍ asya̱ sthūṇā̱ vi bhrā̍jate di̱vy a1̱̍śvāja̍nīva | bha̱dre kṣetre̱ nimi̍tā̱ tilvi̍le vā sa̱nema̱ madhvo̱ adhi̍gartyasya ||
english: Golden-garmented, its pillar is of iron; it gleams in the sky like a (great) horse-born; fixed in a beautiful field, in a well-tilled land — may we win the mead of the seat (of the sun).

sanskrit: hira̍ṇyarūpam u̱ṣaso̱ vyu̍ṣṭā̱v aya̍ḥsthūṇa̱m udi̍tā̱ sūrya̍sya | ā ro̍hatho varuṇa mitra̱ garta̱m ata̍ś cakṣāthe̱ adi̍ti̱ṁ diti̍ṁ ca ||
english: Of golden form at the shining forth of the dawn, with its iron pillar at the rising of the sun — you ascend, O Varuṇa and Mitra, the seat of honour; from there you two behold Aditi and Diti.

sanskrit: yad baṁhi̍ṣṭha̱ṁ nāti̱vidhe̍ sudānū̱ acchi̍dra̱ṁ śarma̍ bhuvanasya gopā | tena̍ no mitrāvaruṇāv aviṣṭa̱ṁ siṣā̍santo jigī̱vāṁsa̍ḥ syāma ||
english: The greatest shelter, which none can pierce, the flawless shelter — O munificent guardians of the world, with that help us, O Mitra-Varuṇa; may we be those who desire (victory) and who conquer.

sanskrit: ṛta̍sya gopā̱v adhi̍ tiṣṭhatho̱ ratha̱ṁ satya̍dharmāṇā para̱me vyo̍mani | yam atra̍ mitrāvaru̱ṇāva̍tho yu̱vaṁ tasmai̍ vṛ̱ṣṭir madhu̍mat pinvate di̱vaḥ ||
english: As guardians of the cosmic order you two stand on the chariot in the highest sky, possessing the laws of truth; him whom you two, Mitra-Varuṇa, protect here — for him the sweet rain swells from heaven.

sanskrit: sa̱mrājā̍v a̱sya bhuva̍nasya rājatho̱ mitrā̍varuṇā vi̱dathe̍ sva̱rdṛśā̍ | vṛ̱ṣṭiṁ vā̱ṁ rādho̍ amṛta̱tvam ī̍mahe̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī vi ca̍ranti ta̱nyava̍ḥ ||
english: You two reign as joint sovereigns of this world, O Mitra-Varuṇa, seeing the sky in the assembly; we crave rain, your bounty, and immortality; the thunders roam across heaven and earth.

sanskrit: sa̱mrājā̍ u̱grā vṛ̍ṣa̱bhā di̱vas patī̍ pṛthi̱vyā mi̱trāvaru̍ṇā̱ vica̍rṣaṇī | ci̱trebhi̍r a̱bhrair upa̍ tiṣṭhatho̱ rava̱ṁ dyāṁ va̍rṣayatho̱ asu̍rasya mā̱yayā̍ ||
english: Joint sovereigns, mighty, bull-like, lords of heaven, omniscient Mitra-Varuṇa, masters of the earth — you two take your stand with brilliant clouds and the roar; you cause the sky to rain by the māyā of the Asura-lord.

sanskrit: mā̱yā vā̍m mitrāvaruṇā di̱vi śri̱tā sūryo̱ jyoti̍ś carati ci̱tram āyu̍dham | tam a̱bhreṇa̍ vṛ̱ṣṭyā gū̍hatho di̱vi parja̍nya dra̱psā madhu̍manta īrate ||
english: Your māyā is established in the sky, O Mitra-Varuṇa; the sun moves as the brilliant weapon of light; him you hide in the sky with cloud and rain; the drops of Parjanya rich in sweetness roll on.

sanskrit: ratha̍ṁ yuñjate ma̱ruta̍ḥ śu̱bhe su̱khaṁ śūro̱ na mi̍trāvaruṇā̱ gavi̍ṣṭiṣu | rajā̍ṁsi ci̱trā vi ca̍ranti ta̱nyavo̍ di̱vaḥ sa̍mrājā̱ paya̍sā na ukṣatam ||
english: The Maruts yoke the chariot for beauty and ease, like heroes in the quest for cattle, O Mitra-Varuṇa; the brilliant thunders roam across the regions; O joint sovereigns of heaven, sprinkle (the earth) with milk.

sanskrit: vāca̱ṁ su mi̍trāvaruṇā̱v irā̍vatīm pa̱rjanya̍ś ci̱trāṁ va̍dati̱ tviṣī̍matīm | a̱bhrā va̍sata ma̱ruta̱ḥ su mā̱yayā̱ dyāṁ va̍rṣayatam aru̱ṇām a̍re̱pasa̍m ||
english: A speech nourishing and full of refreshing rain, brilliant and full of gleam — Parjanya speaks it well, O Mitra-Varuṇa; the Maruts clothe the clouds with their māyā; cause the pure, reddish sky to rain.

sanskrit: dharma̍ṇā mitrāvaruṇā vipaścitā vra̱tā ra̍kṣethe̱ asu̍rasya mā̱yayā̍ | ṛ̱tena̱ viśva̱m bhuva̍na̱ṁ vi rā̍jatha̱ḥ sūrya̱m ā dha̍ttho di̱vi citrya̱ṁ ratha̍m ||
english: By the cosmic law, wise Mitra-Varuṇa, you guard the divine ordinances through the Asura's māyā; by the cosmic order you rule over all the world; you two fix in the sky the wondrous chariot of the sun.

sanskrit: varu̍ṇaṁ vo ri̱śāda̍sam ṛ̱cā mi̱traṁ ha̍vāmahe | pari̍ vra̱jeva̍ bā̱hvor ja̍ga̱nvāṁsā̱ sva̍rṇaram ||
english: With a verse-hymn we call to you Varuṇa, the destroyer of foes, and Mitra — those two who have encompassed the solar hero (or: the good man of heaven) with their arms as if with an embrace.

sanskrit: tā bā̱havā̍ suce̱tunā̱ pra ya̍ntam asmā̱ arca̍te | śeva̱ṁ hi jā̱rya̍ṁ vā̱ṁ viśvā̍su̱ kṣāsu̱ jogu̍ve ||
english: Those two arms, with clear perception, going forward for the singer of praise — for your dear, intimate (grace) in all the dwellings I have continually called.

sanskrit: yan nū̱nam a̱śyāṁ gati̍m mi̱trasya̍ yāyām pa̱thā | asya̍ pri̱yasya̱ śarma̱ṇy ahi̍ṁsānasya saścire ||
english: If now I might attain the path, might I travel the road of Mitra — in the shelter of this dear one, the unhurt, they have come together (found their union).

sanskrit: yu̱vābhyā̍m mitrāvaruṇopa̱maṁ dhe̍yām ṛ̱cā | yad dha̱ kṣaye̍ ma̱ghonā̱ṁ stotṝ̱ṇāṁ ca̍ spū̱rdhase̍ ||
english: To you two, Mitra-Varuṇa, may I offer the highest (praise) with a hymn; for in the abode of the bountiful ones you strive in rivalry with the praisers.

sanskrit: ā no̍ mitra sudī̱tibhi̱r varu̍ṇaś ca sa̱dhastha̱ ā | sve kṣaye̍ ma̱ghonā̱ṁ sakhī̍nāṁ ca vṛ̱dhase̍ ||
english: Mitra with his bright flames, and Varuṇa, (come) to our common seat; in the abode of the bountiful ones and of your friends, for increase.

sanskrit: yu̱vaṁ no̱ yeṣu̍ varuṇa kṣa̱tram bṛ̱hac ca̍ bibhṛ̱thaḥ | u̱ru ṇo̱ vāja̍sātaye kṛ̱taṁ rā̱ye sva̱staye̍ ||
english: You two bear among those, O Varuṇa, sovereignty and great might; make wide for us for the winning of prizes, for wealth, for well-being.

sanskrit: u̱cchantyā̍m me yaja̱tā de̱vakṣa̍tre̱ ruśa̍dgavi | su̱taṁ soma̱ṁ na ha̱stibhi̱r ā pa̱ḍbhir dhā̍vataṁ narā̱ bibhra̍tāv arca̱nāna̍sam ||
english: For me at the shining forth of the dawn, in the divine field, with the gleaming cattle — like pressed soma, O heroes, come running with (your) hands and feet, you two bearing the worship-face (or: the face that does not worship).

sanskrit: yaś ci̱keta̱ sa su̱kratu̍r deva̱trā sa bra̍vītu naḥ | varu̍ṇo̱ yasya̍ darśa̱to mi̱tro vā̱ vana̍te̱ gira̍ḥ ||
english: He who perceives is of good insight; let him speak to us of the divine realm — he whose prayers the visible Varuṇa or Mitra delights in.

sanskrit: tā hi śreṣṭha̍varcasā̱ rājā̍nā dīrgha̱śrutta̍mā | tā satpa̍tī ṛtā̱vṛdha̍ ṛ̱tāvā̍nā̱ jane̍-jane ||
english: Those two are kings of greatest lustre, of most far-reaching fame; those two lords of the good who increase the cosmic order, who possess the cosmic order, in every generation.

sanskrit: tā vā̍m iyā̱no 'va̍se̱ pūrvā̱ upa̍ bruve̱ sacā̍ | svaśvā̍sa̱ḥ su ce̱tunā̱ vājā̍m̐ a̱bhi pra dā̱vane̍ ||
english: Coming to you two for help, I invoke together the ancient (prayers) in your company; O you of good horses and clear perception, for the giving forth of prizes.

sanskrit: mi̱tro a̱ṁhoś ci̱d ād u̱ru kṣayā̍ya gā̱tuṁ va̍nate | mi̱trasya̱ hi pra̱tūrva̍taḥ suma̱tir asti̍ vidha̱taḥ ||
english: Mitra wins even from distress a broad path to dwell; for there is the good favour of Mitra who rushes forward, for the worshipper.

sanskrit: va̱yam mi̱trasyāva̍si̱ syāma̍ sa̱pratha̍stame | a̱ne̱hasa̱s tvota̍yaḥ sa̱trā varu̍ṇaśeṣasaḥ ||
english: May we be in the shelter of Mitra, the most widely renowned; sinless, with your help, those who have Varuṇa's protection entire.

sanskrit: yu̱vam mi̍tre̱maṁ jana̱ṁ yata̍tha̱ḥ saṁ ca̍ nayathaḥ | mā ma̱ghona̱ḥ pari̍ khyata̱m mo a̱smāka̱m ṛṣī̍ṇāṁ gopī̱the na̍ uruṣyatam ||
english: You two, O Mitra, restrain this people and lead it together; do not pass over the bountiful; in your protection, let us not come to harm, of our seers — rescue (us).
